newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks off in London as Dow loses ground.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks off in London as Dow loses ground.

text.p: Hong Kong shares were slightly weaker in London on Tuesday, tracking a pullback on Wall Street, dealers said.
The Hang Seng London Reference index was down 28.15 to 12,720.76 at 1548 GMT, but volume was thin, they said.

Hang Seng Bank Ltd 011q.L staged a bit of a recovery early in the London session, but then eased from the day's best level when Wall Street lost ground, dealers said. The shares were up HK$0.32 to HK$82.15.
"The rest of the market just sort of fell in sympathy," said one London dealer. "The market is down, I believe, on uncertainty about U.S. rates and Wall Street."
In Hong Kong, the benchmark Hang Seng index lost 89.62 points 12,748.91.
